classification.difficultyReason: Move from a numerical comparison to a general explanation by representing both percentage expressions algebraically and using commutativity of multiplication.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Which is greater: $15\%$ of $80$ or $80\%$ of $15$?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}15\%\text{ of }80&=15\%\times80\\15\%\text{ of }80&=0.15\times80\\15\%\text{ of }80&=12\\80\%\text{ of }15&=80\%\times15\\80\%\text{ of }15&=0.80\times15\\80\%\text{ of }15&=12\end{align*}$$
They are equal.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Explain why $x\%$ of $y$ will also be equal to $y\%$ of $x$.

answer.short: They are equal because both are $\dfrac{xy}{100}$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x\%\text{ of }y&=\frac{x}{100}\times y\\x\%\text{ of }y&=\frac{xy}{100}\\y\%\text{ of }x&=\frac{y}{100}\times x\\y\%\text{ of }x&=\frac{xy}{100}\end{align*}$$
So, they are equal.
